basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old agricultural enthusiast from the UK, currently working as a software developer with a penchant for simulation games. I spend my evenings and weekends immersed in the world of Farming Simulator, often sharing tips and tricks with fellow gamers. Aside from gaming, I enjoy tinkering with Linux distributions and am an avid follower of the South Carolina Gamecocks. I'm single, enjoy traveling to rural areas, and make it a point to contribute to discussions about sustainable farming practices. My typical online hours are late evenings, after a long day at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from a local university. My love for farming simulations stems from my family's history in agriculture, and I've combined this with my tech skills to enhance my gaming experience. Over the years, I've self-taught many aspects of coding, specifically in modding and game optimization, which I actively share on subreddits like 'modguide'.
